calls.feedback: CHANGES REQUIRED: the clause Precedence(at_exit, switch_toggled) has the arguments in the wrong order. The task 'If you reach the exit, you must have flipped the switch first' means switch_toggled must precede the first at_exit, which is Precedence(switch_toggled, at_exit). The compiled machine confirms the mismatch: the current clause forbids switch_toggled before at_exit (it even sends the machine to a rejecting well when the switch is toggled before the exit), the opposite of the requirement. Swap the arguments to Precedence(switch_toggled, at_exit); no other clause is needed, since the condition at_exit is not a goal and an empty FINAL_STATES is valid for this rule-only task.
NO CHANGES NEEDED: reaching the exit is only the condition of an 'if' sentence, not a commanded goal, so Precedence(switch_toggled, at_exit) hard alone is correct and the rule-only warning is valid.
